name: Progression - Change of Provider, Provider B Approved
description: SLD POSTs the same short course (ZSC00001) for the same learner with Provider A. Without Provider A ever being approved, SLD then POSTs the same course again for Provider B. The employer approves Provider B's record only.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Creates a Short Course
SLD (Provider B) Creates the Same Short Course
Employer Approves Provider B Short Course
